nn.param.include_source.description: Include extracted VBA source for XLSM files.
nn.param.overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing output file.
nn.err.extension: input must be an .xlsx or .xlsm file
nn.err.output_exists: utdatafil eksisterer allerede: {path}; set overwrite=true for å erstatte den
nn.param.password.description: Optional password for an encrypted workbook.
nn.err.same_output: output_path must not be the input file
